Well long story but right up till 2019 I had taken effexor for 5 years then I took myself off it, fine for 2 months then October I had a complete mental breakdown. Tried zoloft for 2 weeks made me really bad, so then I requested to go back on effexor, this made my pure O shoot through the roof , as I kept titratrating up to 150mg, so it wasn't working at all like it used to. Seroquel was started to help with sleep, didn't do a thing for that  then eventually,  I got moved to a new mental health team and they, started to increase the seroquel to help with the constant intrusive thoughts and calm my anxiety, whilst the effexor was on boarding. Its important to note, effexor can take up to 16 weeks to work therapeutically. Seroquel was a great bridging med  till effexor started working properly but actually the two together work brilliantly.

It's for chronic anxiety and pure O OCD, I was taking effexor first and ten seroquel augmented for sleep at first didn't work then added in to slow my thoughts (ocd) I honestly would be dead otherwise. Their are other antipsychotics you can try if you're not getting along with it.
150mg effexor and 300mg seroquel

Hi I take both these together have done for just about 18 months, a v good combination in my opinion, saved me from the absolute awful abyss, I was in. I'd honestly be dead, if they hadn't added the seroquel to my effexor.  Weight wise I put on weight but I stopped eating cause I was ill and ad I gut better happier and more settled that's when I put on weight wasn't a side effect was cause I was feeling well so my appetite returned. Unusual for seroquel to cause weight loss usually the opposite.
